mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO lecture_progress ( user_id, lecture_id, total_segments, last_watched_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{lectureId}, #{totalSegments}, 0 )
INSERT INTO lecture_progress_segment ( progress_id, segment_index, completed_yn ) VALUES ( #{progressId}, #{segmentIndex}, 'Y' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE progress_id = progress_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lecture_progress_segment WHERE progress_id = #{progressId} AND completed_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE lecture_progress SET completed_segments = #{completedSegments}, completed_yn = CASE WHEN completed_segments / total_segments >= #{completeRatio} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END WHERE progress_id = #{progressId}
